title: Manager, FP&A
description:
About Airwallex 
 Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Rippling, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.
 Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.
 Attributes We Value 
 We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.
 You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.
 About the role 
 This role will be a key member of the AWX Finance team. As a senior analyst in the Finance & Strategy team, you will be responsible for supporting the financial planning and analysis function across AWX globally. You will assist in providing strategic financial insights, analyzing business performance, and contributing to decision-making processes. Reporting to the Finance & Strategy Manager, you will work closely with cross-functional teams and various stakeholders across Finance to ensure accurate financial forecasting, budgeting, and reporting.
 Responsibilities: 
 Support quarterly and annual budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring accuracy and consistency to achieve Airwallex’s short & long-term goals
 Maintain and update existing reports, models and dashboards for regular financial reporting to stakeholders
 Assist in analyzing key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial data, providing insights and reports on areas of concern to business partners. 
 Collaborate with stakeholder and business partners to conduct in-depth financial analysis to manage costs, identify optimisation opportunities and evaluate division profitability
 Support ongoing enhancement of AWX management reporting system
 Collaborate with cross-functional finance teams on finance-wide projects and contribute to process improvements opportunities across Finance
 What you will bring: 
 4-7 years of relevant experience, with a Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field. CPA or equivalent advanced finance qualification preferred
 Sound knowledge of financial analysis and planning, especially in budgeting, forecasting, cost allocations, accounting principles and developing financial models
 Prior experience or understanding of financial services and fintech businesses is a plus
 Strong attention to detail, analytical in nature, with ability to synthesize complex financial data into clear insights
 Proficiency with G-Suite, Microsoft Excel or other spreadsheet tools. Experience with SQL, data visualisation tools, financial software and management reporting systems will be advantageous
 Foster a culture of high performance, collaboration and continuous improvement within the Finance & Strategy function
 Self-motivated and entrepreneuria
